items.title: GP clinic network hit by major cyber breach
items.description: Partnered Health, which operates more than 50 general practice and skin cancer clinics across Australia, has identified more than a dozen clinics where it fears patient information was taken.

items.title: Ex-Sydney church turned LGBT nightclub ordered to 'cease offensive trading'
items.description: The LGBTQIA+ venue said it was exploring its legal options after being issued with a breach of lease notice just days after opening at a former Sydney church.

items.title: ICE suspends vehicle stops after two deadly shootings
items.description: US Immigration and Customs Enforcement orders its officers to suspend most vehicle stops after agents fatally shot two men six days apart during stops in Maine and Texas.

items.title: An alias and a dead man's name: Former ATO executive charged with fraud
items.description: Former assistant tax commissioner Nick Petroulias has been charged with multiple fraud offences, accused of obtaining financial advantage by deception and using false documents.

items.title: Trump beats his own record for strategic backflips on Iran
items.description: Donald Trump's actions this week have only confirmed he has run out of options and is now engaged in a simple war of wills, and calculations on who will run out of munitions first, with an enemy that he has underestimated from the start.

items.title: Police investigate attempted sexual assault of Melbourne dog walkers
items.description: Police are investigating after two women reported that a man attempted to assault them before the dogs they were walking chased him away.

items.title: Labor takes a stand on data centre rules and AI copyright
items.description: The prime minister has unveiled Labor's plan for new AI national standards, warning Australia has a narrow window to set AI's "social licence". A new set of standards for artificial intelligence will provide clear rules for data centres, forcing them to minimise water usage and underwrite or supply their own power. Anthony Albanese has vowed AI companies will not be able to use Australian books, music, art or news to train AI "without the artist's control".

items.title: Disgraced footballer Nicky Winmar removed from AFL Hall of Fame
items.description: Winmar was found guilty earlier this month of three counts of unlawful assault and common law assault.

items.title: Sydney uni chief regrets handling of pro-Palestinian encampments
items.description: A royal commission hears how both the universities of Melbourne and Sydney have improved processes for students to make complaints in the wake of antisemitic experiences by staff and students, which escalated in 2024.

items.title: One-way 'speedboats with explosives' launched by US for first time
items.description: The United States is using one-way drone boats in combat against Iran for the first time in its military history. A defence expert says America is catching on to this "cheaper and more effective" tactic employed by Iran and Ukraine.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
